verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents an official MCP server built into its dg CLI that gives AI coding tools direct access to Deepgram APIs, and a probe confirms the MCP server documentation page exists. That is the product itself delivering the story's capability. missing for 10: documented tool inventory and setup/configuration details (transport, auth, client config) in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting via the MCP server

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The dg CLI includes a built-in MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that gives AI coding tools direct access to Deepgram APIs.
